Q4883014.label: 2003 Belizean general election
Q4883014.summary: General elections were held in Belize on 5 March 2003. Belizeans elected 29 members to the House of Representatives for a term of five years. The result was a victory for the ruling People's United Party (PUP), which won 22 of the 29 seats.

Q215622.label: 2010 United Kingdom general election
Q215622.desc: election of members to the House of Commons in 2010
Q215622.summary: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on 6 May 2010 to elect 650 MPs to the House of Commons. This was the first election to be held after the minimum age of candidacy was reduced from 21 to 18. As of 2026, it remains the last UK general election to produce a Prime Minister who lasted a full term of office.

Q702022.label: 1983 West German federal election
Q702022.summary: A federal election was held in West Germany on 6 March 1983 to elect the members of the 10th Bundestag. The CDU/CSU alliance led by Helmut Kohl remained the largest faction in parliament, with Kohl remaining Chancellor.

Q3722310.label: 1962 Albanian parliamentary election
Q3722310.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in the People's Republic of Albania on 3 June 1962. The Democratic Front was the only party able to contest the elections, and subsequently won all 214 seats. Voter turnout was reported to be 100%, with only seven registered voters not voting.

Q116730950.label: 1951 Russian Supreme Soviet election
Q116730950.summary: Supreme Soviet elections were held in the Russian SFSR on 18 February 1951, as part of regional elections across the Soviet Union.

Q2900038.label: 1998 Israeli presidential election
Q2900038.summary: An election for President of Israel was held in the Knesset on 4 March 1998.

Q28036166.label: assassination of Andrei Karlov
Q28036166.desc: 2016 murder of the Russian ambassador to Turkey
Q28036166.summary: Andrei Karlov, the Russian Ambassador to Turkey, was assassinated by Mevlüt Mert Altıntaş, an off-duty Turkish police officer, at an art exhibition in Ankara, Turkey, on the evening of 19 December 2016. The assassination took place after several days of protests in Turkey over Russian involvement in the Syrian Civil War and the battle over Aleppo.

Q44102.label: Party of Socialists and Democrats
Q44102.summary: The Party of Socialists and Democrats is a social-democratic and democratic socialist political party in San Marino. It is a member of the Socialist International, and observer member of the Party of European Socialists. It is the only Sammarinese party with a reference to the European Union in its official political symbol. Its current-day Italian counterpart is the Democratic Party.
